name: Survey tile in Libra
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.1 degrees south of the ecliptic in Libra, imaged by SPHEREx 18 times in 7 visits over 73 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 34 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.1 days starting 2026-02-16, at wavelengths from 0.94 to 4.70 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
